data.one_liner: Extends the Flutter camera plugin to stream live video over RTMP on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Extends the official Flutter camera plugin with methods to stream live video directly to an RTMP endpoint. It supports features like starting/pausing streams, simultaneous video recording, and retrieving stream statistics.
use_when: You need to build a live streaming application that pushes video via RTMP.
You are already using the camera plugin and want RTMP broadcasting without changing your camera UI flow.
avoid_when: You need web support (the package explicitly states web is not supported).
You require an alternative protocol like WebRTC or HLS without RTMP broadcasting.
strengths: Familiar API mirroring the standard Flutter camera plugin.
Supports simultaneous recording to a local file while streaming.
Handles complex native RTMP client implementations under the hood.
weaknesses: Under active development with potential breaking changes between versions.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSCameraUsageDescription and NSMicrophoneUsageDescription keys to Info.plist on iOS, and setting minSdkVersion to 21 or higher in Android build.gradle.
